_comment: Ready-to-fire payload for the Higgsfield MCP tool generate_video_batch. Track A, 11 clips. Seedance 2.0 has NO negative-prompt parameter, so the pack's NEGATIVE block is folded into each prompt as a trailing avoid-clause. Submit in two batches (max 12 per call, but A03 must land and be reviewed first).
_run_order: 1. Submit index 3 (A03) alone. Regenerate until the clerk head is COMPLETELY blank.
2. Save that frame, upload via media_upload, then add it to A03/A05/A11 as medias[{role:'image_references'}] for AMIR/character lock.
3. Submit the remaining 10 indices in one generate_video_batch call.
4. jobs_wait in groups of <=12, then one show_generation_by_ids for the full set.

_common_params.note: generate_audio false = silent plates; VO and BURN-IN text are added in the edit, never generated. mode std is required for 1080p.

requests._scene: A01 THE HOOK | 0:00.0-0:05.0 | trim 10s gen to 5.00s | MOVE locked off

params.prompt: Macro close-up of a single blank cream payment card lying flat on a dark matte charcoal desk beside a closed manila folder, no text or markings on the card at all. A simplified geometric hand in a deep navy #1E3A5F sleeve enters from the right, sets one fingertip on the card, and slides it a short distance to the left, away from camera, then withdraws. The card settles and holds. Stylised low-poly 3D, matte clay shading, near-photorealistic card stock and paper texture. Camera locked off, no movement at all — the only motion in frame is the hand. Single hard key light from camera-left, one long real shadow thrown right, deep near-black surround, one warm amber glint on the card edge. Shallow cinematic depth of field. 9:16 vertical, subject in the lower two-thirds, clean headroom above for captions. Absolutely no text, lettering, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere. No facial features of any kind. No cel shading, no 2D illustration, no camera shake, no morphing or warping.

Single hard overhead key slightly off-axis so both shadows fall the same way, deep near-black background, one warm amber accent. Slow deliberate motion, no camera shake. 9:16 vertical, cards in the lower two-thirds. Absolutely no text, lettering, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere. No facial features of any kind. No cel shading, no 2D illustration, no camera shake, no morphing or warping.
